title: Wi-Fi keeps dropping
symptom: Laptop disconnects from Wi-Fi every few minutes
user_description: My laptop keeps losing Wi-Fi every few minutes and then reconnects. My colleagues don't seem to have the problem.

options.why: Disconnects everyone and does nothing for a fault on one laptop.

options.text: Replace every access point in the building
options.why: Wildly expensive, and colleagues are fine, so the access points are not the problem.

options.text: Find out whether others are affected, check signal strength where he sits, and check the Wi-Fi adapter's power saving setting and driver
options.why: Colleagues are fine, so look at his laptop and location. A weak signal, a power saving setting that turns the adapter off, or an outdated driver are the usual causes.

options.text: Tell him to use his phone hotspot instead
options.why: Moves business traffic onto personal data and ignores the fault.

hints: Is it the network or one laptop?
What could make a laptop switch off its own Wi-Fi to save power?
Does the problem follow him to other places?
real_world_tip: Ask whether it happens in other rooms. If it only happens at one desk, it points to signal rather than the laptop.
